title: Sherlock Holmes: A Study in Scarlet — Ep 12/14 — "The Avenging Angels"
description:
A Study in Scarlet, Episode 12. All night Jefferson Hope drives John Ferrier and his daughter through the defiles of the Utah mountains, a day ahead of the Avenging Angels.

On the second day the food runs out. Hope makes a fire in a sheltered nook, leaves the old man and the girl beside it, and goes off with his rifle after whatever the mountains will give him. He loses his way among the gorges until dark, and comes back to a dead fire, a ground stamped by hooves, and a low heap of red soil with a stick and a paper in it.

Six days later he stands above Salt Lake City again, gaunt and white-faced, while a rider comes up the canyon with the news of Lucy Ferrier -- and in the grey of a morning a door is flung open on the room where the wives of Drebber sit up with the dead.

Chapter V of Part Two of Arthur Conan Doyle's A Study in Scarlet (1887), in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
